project_type: Monorepo: FastAPI async backend (cloud_api) + Flutter client (mobileraker) that talk over a stable HTTP contract. The live supply API is the cloud_api app-package FastAPI app.
build_system: Backend: pip + uvicorn, tables via SQLAlchemy Base.metadata.create_all at startup (NO Alembic for the app/ package; alembic/ targets the separate src/ app only). Flutter: standard flutter tooling; package name is 'mobileraker'; uses dependency_overrides for common (path: common). Flutter SDK >=3.16.5, Dart >=3.2.3.
test_framework: Backend: none present (write a local smoke test). Flutter: flutter_test (test/ dir).
build_command: Backend: from cloud_api/ -> python -m pip install -r requirements.txt ; python -c "import app.main". Flutter: from repo root -> flutter pub get.
test_command: Backend: python -m py_compile app/routers/supply.py app/models/supply.py app/schemas/supply.py + local uvicorn smoke test (see verification_instructions). Flutter: flutter test test/features/supply_hub/inventory_notifier_test.dart ; flutter analyze lib/features/supply_hub.

contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering present. Keep the HTTP contract shape stable (same paths, same JSON field names). Match each project's style: FastAPI async SQLAlchemy on the backend; hooks_riverpod/StateNotifier/hive_flutter/freezed/json_serializable on the client. Commit locally on the branch; never push.
key_patterns: Flutter local-persistence pattern to mirror EXACTLY: lib/service/local_filament_stock_service.dart -> 'static const String boxName', a _loadFromHive() guarded by 'if (Hive.isBoxOpen(boxName))' called in the StateNotifier constructor, and writes on every mutation via 'final box = await Hive.openBox<String>(boxName); await box.put(id, json.toJson());' / 'box.delete(id)'. App boxes open in lib/app_setup.dart openBoxes() as a Future.wait([ Hive.openBox<...>('name'), ... ]) and are deleted in deleteBoxes() via Hive.deleteBoxFromDisk('name'). The supply client device_id lives in Hive.box('settingsbox') key 'supply_hub_device_id'. Backend supply router uses FastAPI APIRouter(prefix='/api/supply'), verify_secret via x-api-key header, async SQLAlchemy select/delete on CloudSupplyItem.
